notes.gross_output: Gross output sums native producing nodes once. It includes intermediate production at multiple supply-chain stages and is not GDP.
notes.domestic_use: Use by model destination: intermediate purchases and final demand, including signed source adjustments. Domestic and imported refer to the native origin region; this is not final consumption alone.
notes.final_demand: Final use keeps final consumption (households, government and NPISH), fixed investment, and inventories/valuables distinct. Native signed adjustments and destination geography are retained.
notes.value_added_footprint: Value added generated by domestic and foreign producers to meet the selected final demand. Consumer columns are retained throughout; production-origin totals are independently reconciled.
notes.ghg_footprint: Allocable production-chain emissions supported by final demand, plus direct final-demand emissions where supplied. Domestic/foreign identifies the production origin relative to the native consumer region. Zero-output production emissions are reported as a separate unallocated residual. Unallocated production emissions: 339,469,159.123 t CO2eq globally (1.221016% of the reviewed production total); kept by production origin, with no consumer allocation. EXIOBASE: mass-reported gases use EDGAR-compatible AR5 GWP100 (CH4=28). HFC/PFC already in source CO2eq retain their original characterisation; its IPCC basis is not independently verified. Production accounts and EDGAR territorial totals have different boundaries.
notes.ghg_trade: Global upstream emissions embodied in gross intermediate and final trade. Each border crossing can include emissions counted at earlier stages, so this is not a final-consumption footprint. Domestic pairs and direct final-user emissions are excluded from international flows. EXIOBASE: mass-reported gases use EDGAR-compatible AR5 GWP100 (CH4=28). HFC/PFC already in source CO2eq retain their original characterisation; its IPCC basis is not independently verified. Production accounts and EDGAR territorial totals have different boundaries. Unallocated zero-output production GHG: 339,469,159.123 t CO2eq globally.
